truth_claims.title: Ashley Bell
truth_claims.author: Dean Koontz
truth_claims.note: conf=0.88; ISBN 9780345545978 confirmed on Goodreads editions page as the Bantam ebook of Ashley Bell (Dec 8, 2015, 576 pp). Full title on title page is "Ashley Bell: A Novel"; canonical title is "Ashley Bell". Series: Koontz released two ebook-original prequel novellas, Last Light and Final Hour, explicitly marketed as "two standalone eBook original novellas leading in to Ashley Bell" (Penguin Random House / Apple Books). Goodreads groups them as the "Ashley Bell" series: Last Light #0.25, Final Hour #0.5, Ashley Bell #1 (Darkest Desires: The Makani Trilogy is the collected omnibus). So the novel is #1 in the Ashley Bell series; it is also self-contained and often shelved as a standalone Koontz novel.

truth_claims.note: conf=0.82; Title, author and ISBN all check out: 9780345545978 is the Bantam ebook edition (Dec 8, 2015) of Ashley Bell by Dean Koontz. Refuting the proposed series=None: the novel is the anchor volume of the "Ashley Bell" sequence, which also includes two publisher-branded tie-in eBook novellas featuring Makani Hisoka-O'Brien — Last Light (2015) and Final Hour (2015/2016), later collected as Darkest Desires: The Makani Trilogy. Fantastic Fiction numbers them 0.1, 0.2, 1; Goodreads numbers them 0.25, 0.5, 1. Ashley Bell is #1 in either scheme. Caveat: the novel is self-contained and often marketed as a standalone, so "series" here reflects the cataloguing convention rather than a multi-novel saga.
